understanding: A sequence can score reasonably on individual positions yet fail the entire task. Teacher forcing supplies correct data prefixes at each position; generation feeds back the model's own choices, so an earlier error changes later input.
materials_and_labels: Desired answer[1,2,3,4]. Handwritten teacher-forced predictions[1,2,0,4] have3/4 positions correct; free-generation predictions[1,2,0,0] have2/4. Both exact-sequence outcomes are failures.
expected_change: Expect code to calculate per-position accuracy and whole-answer success separately, followed by a comparison with loss.
confusion_and_quote: No necessary confusion at this point. These are explicitly「兩份手寫預測」, so I do not treat the later zero as empirical proof about error propagation in a trained model.
missing_visuals: None needed yet; all four desired and predicted positions are displayed for direct comparison.

concept_checks.identity: Two different sources of prefix context during scoring/generation.
concept_checks.mechanism: Correct data prefix is supplied independently per position under teacher forcing; generated prefix incorporates earlier model choices.
concept_checks.need: Evaluate whether the model actually delivers a complete answer, since token predictions under correct context may conceal downstream consequences of its own errors.
concept_checks.usage: Compare desired and predicted sequences position by position, then ask whether every required position matches.
concept_checks.example_scope: Hand arrays illustrate distinct metrics and conditions, not measured model behavior or a quantified generalization gap.
concept_checks.source_quote: 因此逐格表現與整題完成要分開記。
